import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load essential data
essential_dir = "./input/essential_data"

# Load CV folds
cv_folds = pd.read_csv(
    os.path.join(essential_dir, "CVfolds_2.txt"),
    sep=" ",
    header=None,
    names=["rec_id", "fold"],
)
train_indices = cv_folds[cv_folds["fold"] == 0]["rec_id"].values
test_indices = cv_folds[cv_folds["fold"] == 1]["rec_id"].values

# Load labels (only training labels available)
labels_df = pd.read_csv(
    os.path.join(essential_dir, "rec_labels_test_hidden.txt"), sep=",", header=None
)
labels_df.columns = ["rec_id"] + [f"sp_{i}" for i in range(19)]
labels_df["rec_id"] = labels_df["rec_id"].astype(int)

# Filter to training set
train_labels = labels_df[labels_df["rec_id"].isin(train_indices)].copy()
train_labels = train_labels.sort_values("rec_id").reset_index(drop=True)

# Load segment features (histogram_of_segments.txt)
histogram_df = pd.read_csv(
    "./input/supplemental_data/histogram_of_segments.txt", sep=",", header=None
)
histogram_df.columns = ["rec_id"] + [f"feat_{i}" for i in range(38)]
histogram_df["rec_id"] = histogram_df["rec_id"].astype(int)

# Merge with train labels
merged = train_labels.merge(histogram_df, on="rec_id")
X_train = merged[[f"feat_{i}" for i in range(38)]].values
y_train = merged[[f"sp_{i}" for i in range(19)]].values

# Split for validation (hold-out)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Train XGBoost one-vs-rest for each species
models = []
for i in range(19):
    model = XGBClassifier(
        n_estimators=200,
        max_depth=6,
        learning_rate=0.1,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        objective="binary:logistic",
        eval_metric="auc",
        tree_method="gpu_hist",
        predictor="gpu_predictor",
        verbosity=0,
        random_state=42,
    )
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr[:, i], eval_set=[(X_val, y_val[:, i])], verbose=False)
    models.append(model)

# Validation AUC-ROC
y_val_pred = np.column_stack([models[i].predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1] for i in range(19)])
auc_scores = [roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], y_val_pred[:, i]) for i in range(19)]
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC per species: {np.mean(auc_scores):.4f}")

# Prepare test predictions
test_labels = labels_df[labels_df["rec_id"].isin(test_indices)].copy()
test_features = histogram_df[histogram_df["rec_id"].isin(test_indices)].copy()
test_features = test_features.sort_values("rec_id").reset_index(drop=True)
X_test = test_features[[f"feat_{i}" for i in range(38)]].values

# Predict on test set
test_pred = np.column_stack([models[i].predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1] for i in range(19)])

# Prepare submission (as per sample_submission.csv format)
submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
submission["Id"] = submission["Id"].astype(int)

# Map test predictions to submission format
# For each test rec_id in test_indices, assign 19 predictions for species 0..18
rec_id_to_idx = {rec_id: idx for idx, rec_id in enumerate(test_indices)}
submission["Probability"] = 0.0

for rec_id in test_indices:
    for sp in range(19):
        idx = rec_id_to_idx[rec_id]
        submission.loc[(submission["Id"] == rec_id * 100 + sp), "Probability"] = (
            test_pred[idx, sp]
        )

# Ensure correct order (should already be, but sort to be safe)
submission = submission.sort_values("Id").reset_index(drop=True)

# Save submission
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
